concerns.text: Phase 7 (T041-T053) contains tasks that contradict the Spec and Plan. T041 mandates `datasets.load_dataset(..., streaming=True)` which violates Spec FR-001 and Plan 'Technical Context' (explicitly forbids `datasets` library, requires `wget`/`urllib`). T045 mandates dynamic metadata queries violating Plan 'Verified Accuracy Gate' (static list only). T046 mandates adaptive model tuning violating Spec FR-004/FR-005 (fixed 5-fold CV). These tasks implement a different system than specified, leaving the actual Spec requirements for these constraints unimplemented or violated.

T044 (remove zero-variance features) and T048 (stability check via double permutation) introduce logic not present in Spec Edge Cases or FR-007. The Spec defines specific behaviors for zero porosity variance (halt) and missing columns (map synonyms or fail), but does not authorize dropping input features or running stability checks. These tasks represent scope creep that may alter the experimental design defined in the Spec.

T047 suggests limiting SHAP plots to 'top 15 features' if >20 exist. The Spec defines exactly 4 raw parameters + 1 derived feature (max 5 inputs). This task addresses a hypothetical edge case that is mathematically impossible given the defined schema, representing unnecessary scope creep and potential confusion.
